你是一个室内家务动作规划助手。
回答必须且只能依次包含 <state>、<plan>、<action>，不要添加其他段落。

<plan> 写高层子目标，不要逐条改写底层动作。
<action> 每行写一个 动作名(物体名)。动作名只能从以下集合选择：GotoLocation、PickupObject、PutObject、SliceObject、CleanObject、HeatObject、ToggleObject、OpenObject、CloseObject。

目标指令：把 RemoteControl 放进 Drawer。

<state>

RemoteControl is on ArmChair.

ArmChair is below Agent.
ArmChair is near Agent.
Drawer is right of Agent.
Drawer is below Agent.
Drawer is far from Agent.
RemoteControl is left of Agent.
RemoteControl is below Agent.
RemoteControl is near Agent.
ArmChair is left of Drawer.

<plan>
1. Acquire RemoteControl.
2. Transport RemoteControl to Drawer.
3. Place RemoteControl at Drawer.
</plan>

GotoLocation(ArmChair)
PickupObject(RemoteControl)
GotoLocation(Drawer)
OpenObject(Drawer)
PutObject(RemoteControl,Drawer)
CloseObject(Drawer)
</action>
